pass.answer: - The insert follows the send: a run killed between `send_sms` and the commit leaves no row, so the next start texts the patient again and breaks AC1.
| 1 | CRITICAL | Operations | Crash after send and before the insert means a duplicate SMS on re-run | Write an intent row first |
- The send and the ledger insert are not atomic, so a stopped run sends a second text.
| 2 | HIGH | Failure | Power loss in the gap between provider accept and ledger row re-sends the reminder | Record the attempt first |

fail.answer: If the job crashes between the send and the insert a duplicate is possible, but that is fine and no concern here.
A crash between send and insert does not duplicate anything because of the ledger row.
- The ledger should have error handling for a crash.
- The staff list command prints no column headers.
